newFeatures: Install LightBench as an app from Chrome or Edge (the install button in the address bar).
Works offline after the first visit. Your photos and library were already stored on your computer.
An “Update ready” notice with these notes. Nothing changes until you click Reload.
Open RAW and JPEG files with the installed app from your file manager (Chrome and Edge).
Copy, paste and sync develop settings between photos, choosing which settings go. Auto can re-run on each photo.
Auto options: a strength slider and a choice of which sliders Auto may change.
Presets: save chosen settings, preview on hover, apply with an Amount, and develop new photos with one automatically.
